scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @signflow/api" "npm run dev -w @signflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @signflow/api && npm run build -w @signflow/web
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -k "NODE_ENV=test WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3100 EVIDENCE_SECRET=ephemeral-e2e-evidence-secret-32-characters JOB_SECRET=ephemeral-e2e-job-secret-32-characters tsx --tsconfig apps/api/tsconfig.json scripts/e2e-server.ts" "E2E=true API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101 npm run dev -w @signflow/web -- --port 3100"
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src packages/shared/src scripts tests *.ts *.mjs *.json docs README.md
